title: Pork Chops with Apple Sauce and Onions
description: This recipe for pork chops are simply seasoned and simmered in applesauce, white wine, butter, and onions then smothered in that mixture for dinner.
ingredients: salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Season pork chops with salt and black pepper.

Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat; add pork chops. Add onion and butter between chops; cook and stir onion until first side chops browned, 5 to 7 minutes. Flip chops; cook until no longer pink in centers, 5 to 7 minutes more. An instant-read thermometer inserted into centers should read 145 degrees F (63 degrees C). Transfer chops to a plate.

Pour white wine into the skillet; bring to a boil while scraping the browned bits of food off of the bottom of the skillet with a wooden spoon. Stir applesauce into onion and wine mixture; simmer until liquid somewhat thickens, about 5 minutes.
Serve pork chops topped with applesauce and onion mixture.
